description.content: [Redis](https://render.com/docs/redis) allows you to interact with your Render Redis instances. This API is deprecated in favor of the Key Value API.

List Redis instances matching the provided filters. If no filters are provided, all Redis instances are returned.
This API is deprecated in favor of the Key Value API.

Filter for resources updated after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)
The ID of the workspaces to return resources for
Filter for resources that belong to an environment
